label: synth_competitor_press_release
draft:
Halden Group has agreed to acquire Norwell Aerospace Components, a leading manufacturer of structural composite components and titanium machined parts, from Westhaven Capital. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2026, subject to customary regulatory approvals.

Norwell, headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, supplies the major commercial aircraft original equipment manufacturers and the leading US defense primes. The Company operates eight manufacturing facilities across the United States and Mexico and employs approximately 3,200 people. Revenue has grown at a compound annual rate of approximately 11 percent over the past five years, supported by the post-pandemic recovery in commercial aerospace and sustained strength in defense end markets.

During Westhaven's ownership, Norwell has invested significantly in advanced composite manufacturing capability. The Company now operates three of the most advanced automated composite layup facilities in North America.

Halden Group will support continued growth in commercial aerospace and an accelerated expansion of Norwell's space applications business, where the Company has identified meaningful capacity to grow share.
